```{r}
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# Both tables come from the owdata harvest, which reads every repository in
# the organisation once a week (openwashdata/owdata#11). The packages table
# supplies the link to each package site.
owd_base <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openwashdata/owdata/main/inst/extdata/"

packages  <- readr::read_csv(paste0(owd_base, "owd_packages.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
variables <- readr::read_csv(paste0(owd_base, "owd_variables.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Variables

Every variable in every dataset of the [data catalogue](/pages/gallery/data/index.qmd),
across all packages. Search for a measurement to find the datasets that hold
it, then follow the package link to its documentation and download.

```{r}
#| output: asis
no_description <- is.na(variables$description) | trimws(variables$description) == ""
cat(sprintf(
  "\n%s variables across %s datasets in %s packages. %s of them have no description yet, shown as *no description*; filling those in is tracked in [openwashdata/owdata#20](https://github.com/openwashdata/owdata/issues/20).\n",
  format(nrow(variables), big.mark = ","),
  n_distinct(paste(variables$pkg_name, variables$dataset_name)),
  n_distinct(variables$pkg_name),
  format(sum(no_description), big.mark = ",")
))
```

:::{.column-page}
```{r}
# DT renders HTML, not markdown, so the links are written as anchors.
link <- function(text, href) {
  paste0('<a href="', href, '">', text, '</a>')
}

tbl <- variables |>
  left_join(packages |> select(pkg_name, url_docs), by = "pkg_name") |>
  mutate(
    Package = ifelse(is.na(url_docs), pkg_name, link(pkg_name, url_docs)),
    Description = ifelse(no_description,
                         '<em class="text-muted">no description</em>',
                         description)
  ) |>
  select(Package, Dataset = dataset_name, Variable = variable_name,
         Type = variable_type, Description) |>
  arrange(Package, Dataset, Variable)

datatable(
  tbl,
  escape = FALSE,
  rownames = FALSE,
  # A fixed id keeps the render reproducible, so the weekly refresh job only
  # opens a pull request when the harvest changed (#157).
  elementId = "data-variables",
  class = "compact stripe hover",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    columnDefs = list(
      # The longest description runs to 1,220 characters. Truncate and keep
      # the full text in the title attribute, so a row stays one or two lines.
      list(
        targets = 4,
        render = JS(
          "function(data, type, row) {",
          "  if (type !== 'display' || data === null) return data;",
          "  var cut = 120;",
          "  if (data.length <= cut) return data;",
          "  return '<span title=\"' + data.replace(/\"/g, '&quot;') + '\">' +",
          "         data.substr(0, cut) + '…</span>';",
          "}"
        )
      ),
      list(targets = 3, className = "dt-nowrap")
    )
  )
)
```
:::
